reply.rationale: The load_data() function reads demand.csv values (in boxes) but never applies the BOX_TO_PIECES=10 conversion factor. The fix multiplies each demand value by BOX_TO_PIECES so that D1=800, D2=900, D3=800 pieces are used in the LP, matching requirement R4.
